title: Pitch to Harbor Seed Fund partners
text:
Pitch meeting with the Harbor Seed Fund partners. Presenting: Maya Chen and Wop testwell. Host: Lena Fischer.

Bring:
- Pitch deck (latest version)
- Live demo of the matching flow on staging
- Westbrook beta numbers: sign-ups, weekly active students, groups that met at least twice
- Campus expansion plan: Lakeside College (January), Crestview State (March)
